references.text: The same chapter describes how the people were to march around the city, which is repeated in verse 7
Describes the armed vanguard that went before the ark, the same arrangement mentioned in verse 7
Shows the fulfillment of the command that the armed vanguard should go before the Lord's ark
Uses the same Hebrew word 'chaluts' (armed) for those who go before the Lord in battle
Mentions the Lord's ark of the covenant carried by the priests, the same ark mentioned in Joshua 6:7
Joshua commands the priests to carry the ark of the covenant before the people, a similar arrangement to that at Jericho
The book of Hebrews refers to the fall of Jericho through faith after the people had marched around the walls for seven days
